description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-proofs/ (#4707) at a Träger with two
schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger transaction, its
release, the kinds, the records, their links and the proofs in one statement
each; then per school only the binding of its tenant transaction for the
access entry. Flat in the number of records and proofs; one tenant
transaction per school (ADR 0089 sections 6 and 7).
